specification.title: Organizations, incentives and culture
specification.outcome: Design organizational responsibilities and incentives that support desired behavior.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original organizational-design cases with explicit principal-agent/task measurement and coordination/delegation mechanisms. Teach incentives, decision rights, culture as actual practices, information flow and gaming/measurement limits. Full role/decision map and implementation/monitoring artifact in each; solve finite or continuous models globally with participation/feasibility and boundaries. Avoid claiming incentives universally determine culture or a metric proves social value.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
